presets.label: OpenAI
presets.keyHint: Create a secret key in your OpenAI account and paste it here.
presets.note: OpenAI answers browsers today, but does not document it. A wrong key shows up as “the browser could not read the answer” on a chat request; the connection check reads the model list first, which says so plainly.

presets.label: Anthropic (Claude)
presets.keyHint: Create an API key in the Anthropic console and paste it here.
presets.note: Anthropic accepts calls from a browser page when they say so with a header, which is added for you.

presets.label: Google Gemini
presets.keyHint: Create a key in Google AI Studio and paste it here.
presets.note: Uses Google's OpenAI-compatible address. Google advises keeping keys for a production service on a server of your own.

presets.label: OpenRouter
presets.keyHint: Create a key at OpenRouter and paste it here. Set a spending limit on the key there.
presets.note: One key for many vendors' models. HTTP-Referer and X-Title are how OpenRouter credits an app; they are optional.

presets.label: A server on this computer
presets.keyHint: Most local servers need no key: leave it empty. Enter one only if you switched on a key in the server.
presets.note: The server has to allow this page ({origin}) to call it, and your browser may ask for permission to reach devices on your local network.

serverKinds.label: Ollama
serverKinds.help: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="{origin}" and pull at least one model.

serverKinds.label: LM Studio
serverKinds.help: Load a model, then start the server in the Developer tab with “Enable CORS” switched on.

serverKinds.label: OAIY
serverKinds.help: Add {origin} to gateway.cors_origins in OAIY's config, or set an API key there and enter it here.

serverKinds.label: llama.cpp or another server
serverKinds.help: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API. For llama.cpp: --cors-origins {origin} --cors-headers Authorization,Content-Type, and --api-key.

presets.label: Another OpenAI-compatible service
presets.keyHint: Paste the key the service gave you.
presets.note: Any service that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API, at an https address ending in its version (for example /v1). It has to allow calls from a browser page.
